title: THE DAYS OF NOAH ARE HERE—VIOLENCE, PERVERSION, AND GLOBAL REBELLION!
paragraphs:
THE DAYS OF NOAH ARE HERE—VIOLENCE, PERVERSION, AND GLOBAL REBELLION!
📖 Matthew 24:37 – "As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man."

Jesus warned us that before His return, the world would look just like it did in the days of Noah.
Look around—what do you see?
A world full of violence.
A society drowning in perversion.
A generation that has turned its back on God.
🚨 We are living in the final moments before judgment. The signs are all around us, yet most people are too distracted to see it.
👉 DON’T BE BLIND TO WHAT’S HAPPENING! READ THIS BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE!

1. THE WORLD IS FILLED WITH VIOLENCE—JUST LIKE IN NOAH’S TIME
📖 Genesis 6:11 – "Now the earth was corrupt in God’s sight, and the earth was filled with violence."

In Noah’s day, the world was drowning in violence, and God had had enough.
Today, history is repeating itself.

🔴 Wars and rumors of wars—Nations are rising against nations.
🔴 Mass shootings, murders, riots—Life has lost its value.
🔴 Lawlessness is increasing—Evil is celebrated, and justice is ignored.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Turn on the news. What do you see? Death, destruction, and hatred spreading like wildfire.
People are more outraged over hurt feelings than over innocent lives being taken.
📖 2 Timothy 3:1-3 – "In the last days, people will be lovers of themselves, boastful, proud, abusive, without love, brutal, and treacherous."
👉 When a society rejects God, violence takes over. And today, we are drowning in it.

2. PERVERSION AND SEXUAL SIN HAVE TAKEN OVER—JUST LIKE IN NOAH’S TIME
📖 Genesis 6:5 – "The Lord saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every intention of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually."

Noah’s generation was consumed by sin, lust, and immorality.
The world today is no different.

🔴 LGBTQ+ agenda pushed on children—Confusion is being normalized.
🔴 Pornography addiction destroying marriages—Lust is celebrated as "freedom."
🔴 Sexual sin everywhere—Casual hookups, adultery, and perversion are glorified.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
People today parade their sin in the streets, demanding that others celebrate it.
What God calls an abomination (Leviticus 18:22), the world calls "progress."
📖 Romans 1:24-27 – "Because of this, God gave them over to shameful lusts... men committed shameful acts with other men and received in themselves the due penalty for their error."
👉 When a society embraces sin, God eventually hands them over to it.

3. THE WORLD HAS REJECTED GOD AND HIS TRUTH—JUST LIKE IN NOAH’S TIME
📖 Genesis 6:3 – "My Spirit shall not strive with man forever."

Before the flood, people ignored Noah’s warnings. They mocked him, continued in sin, and lived as if judgment would never come.
The same is happening today.

🔴 The Bible is banned in schools, but sin is promoted.
🔴 Christians are mocked for standing for truth, but wickedness is celebrated.
🔴 People openly blaspheme God without fear of judgment.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Noah preached for 120 years. Not a single person repented.
Today, the world laughs at those who preach repentance, just like they laughed at Noah—until the rain began to fall.
📖 2 Peter 3:3-4 – "In the last days, scoffers will come, saying, ‘Where is this coming He promised?’"
👉 The same world that rejected Noah’s warnings is rejecting the warnings today. But judgment is coming.

4. GOD’S JUDGMENT IS COMING—JUST LIKE IN NOAH’S TIME
📖 Matthew 24:39 – "They knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away."

The people in Noah’s time didn’t believe judgment was coming—until it was too late.
They ignored the warnings, and the flood destroyed them all.

🔴 Today, God is warning the world again.
🔴 The flood of judgment is coming—not with water, but with fire.
🔴 Jesus is coming soon, and this time, there will be no second chances.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Just like in Noah’s day, the warnings are everywhere.
The signs are clear.
But most people refuse to listen.
📖 2 Thessalonians 1:8-9 – "He will punish those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus."
👉 When the floodgates of God’s judgment open, there will be no escape.

5. THE DOOR OF SALVATION WILL SOON CLOSE—JUST LIKE IN NOAH’S TIME
📖 Genesis 7:16 – "Then the Lord shut him in."

When the rain started, it was too late.
The door to the ark was shut by God Himself—and no one else could enter.

🔴 Today, Jesus is the ark.
🔴 The door is still open—but not for long.
🔴 Once it closes, there will be no second chances.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
People mock the return of Jesus just like they mocked Noah.
But when the trumpet sounds, their laughter will turn into screams.
📖 Luke 13:25 – "Once the owner of the house gets up and closes the door, you will stand outside knocking and pleading, ‘Lord, open the door for us!’ But He will answer, ‘I don’t know you.’"
👉 Are you inside the ark, or will you be left outside?

FINAL WARNING: DON’T WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE!
📖 Hebrews 3:15 – "Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts."

🔥 THE WORLD IS DROWNING IN SIN—BUT JESUS IS THE ONLY WAY TO BE SAVED!
❌ Don’t be like those who ignored Noah’s warnings.
❌ Don’t wait until the rain starts falling.
❌ Don’t gamble with your soul.

💡 REAL-LIFE DECISION:
You have two choices:
✔️ Surrender to Jesus and be saved.
❌ Ignore the warnings and face judgment.
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."
👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

POWERFUL PRAYER TO ESCAPE GOD’S JUDGMENT
"Lord Jesus, I repent of my sins. I see the signs, and I know You are coming soon. I don’t want to be left outside when the door closes. Save me, change me, and make me ready for Your return. In Jesus’ name, AMEN."
